reason: I've never heard of Mëva and there are no reviews, and I took magnesium tablets last year and felt nothing. With the bills going up, £24.99 for a brand I can't check is too much of a gamble for me right now.
objection: I have no way of knowing whether these gummies do anything, or whether this is just another brand that will be gone in a year. The 'finish your first jar' guarantee helps, but I'd still be paying £25 up front and chasing a refund.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews from women my age in the UK who say they noticed a difference after a few weeks, and a proper way to see who is behind the brand.
